title: Lipschitz on every closed unit grid cube implies Lipschitz along segments
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, f : Euclid P → Euclid P, S ⊆ Euclid P and K ≥ 0. Assume that for every z ∈ ℤ^P and all x, y ∈ S with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 and z_i ≤ y_i ≤ z_i + 1 for every i, dist(f(x), f(y)) ≤ K·dist(x, y). Then dist(f(x), f(y)) ≤ K·dist(x, y) for all x, y ∈ Euclid P whose closed segment [x, y] is contained in S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → (∀ (z : Fin P → ℤ) (x y : Euclid P), x ∈ S → y ∈ S → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + 1) → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ K * dist x y) → ∀ x y : Euclid P, segment ℝ x y ⊆ S → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ K * dist x y
